metric_name: 反贿赂/反贪污管理体系
query: 反贿赂/反贪污管理体系 反贿赂/反贪污管理体系 衡量企业是否建立并披露了正式的、覆盖全面的反贿赂与反贪污政策体系，以及该体系在董事会监督、适用范围与第三方管理方面的完备程度。 2分：企业同时满足以下三项标准。第一，披露了正式的反贪污/反贿赂政策或行为守则中的专门反贪污章节。第二，披露了董事会或专门委员会对反贪污合规的监督职责。第三，将反贪污要求延伸至第三方，例如对供应商或商业伙伴提出反贪污合规要求。 1分：企业满足上述2分标准中的任意一项或两项。 0分：企业在公开披露中未涉及任何反贪污政策或管理体系信息。或者，仅以“本公司禁止贪污贿赂行为”等笼统表述一笔带过，无任何可验证的具体内容。 反贿赂 反贪污 反腐败 廉洁政策 行为守则 董事会监督 第三方尽调 疏通费 礼品招待 ABC anti-bribery anti-corruption ABC policy code of conduct board oversight of integrity third-party due diligence facilitation payments gifts and hospitality ABC 是否有正式反贿赂/反贪污政策或行为守则专章？ 董事会或专门委员会如何监督？ 要求是否延伸至供应商/商业伙伴？ 适用范围覆盖哪些员工与地区？ 有哪些培训、尽调或监控措施？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '反贿赂/反贪污管理体系'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有正式反贿赂/反贪污政策或行为守则专章？ 董事会或专门委员会如何监督？ 要求是否延伸至供应商/商业伙伴？ 适用范围覆盖哪些员工与地区？ 有哪些培训、尽调或监控措施？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“禁止贪污贿赂”一句话；仅有举报热线；仅有未明确涉及反贪污的一般风险监督；仅有对外捐赠合规。区分：供应商反腐专题可计第三方延伸要素，但不能自动计企业政策或董事会监督；举报人保护关注渠道和反报复；道德采购关注多维采购标准。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Quality and Reliable Service / Valuing Customer Privacy and Persistence in Information Accuracy
results.text: The Group has been trying to incorporate the sustainable practice into its supply chain management. We seek to work with suppliers who share the same value with us. Apart from evaluating the cost, reputation and delivery of potential suppliers' products and services, the Group also considers their social and environmental performances, such as product and service quality, ethical conduct and environmental conservation. Taking Sun Ferry as an example, Sun Ferry has stipulated its ESG requirements for suppliers in a Supplier Code of Conduct , and favours suppliers who could demonstrate commitments to uphold sustainability principles listed in the code during suppliers' selection process.

Quality and Reliable Service / Valuing Customer Privacy and Persistence in Information Accuracy

[Content]
The Group has been trying to incorporate the sustainable practice into its supply chain management. We seek to work with suppliers who share the same value with us. Apart from evaluating the cost, reputation and delivery of potential suppliers' products and services, the Group also considers their social and environmental performances, such as product and service quality, ethical conduct and environmental conservation. Taking Sun Ferry as an example, Sun Ferry has stipulated its ESG requirements for suppliers in a Supplier Code of Conduct , and favours suppliers who could demonstrate commitments to uphold sustainability principles listed in the code during suppliers' selection process.

results.section: Quality and Reliable Service / Valuing Customer Privacy and Persistence in Information Accuracy
results.text: The major suppliers of the Group are terminal machinery, components, oils and lubricants suppliers and ferry owners. Under the principles of 'transparency, fairness, impartiality and honesty', the Group has established a comprehensive tendering evaluation system and set up stringent supplier screening procedures in the Management Measures for Tendering and Bidding and the Procedures of Procurement Management, regulating the management of different types of suppliers of the Group. A total of 234 suppliers were covered in the evaluation during the Reporting Period. The Group's Technical Support Department works closely together with relevant departments to identify suitable suppliers and to assess their qualifications and performance. At least three potential suppliers would be invited for tendering for the Group to choose the right suppliers.

The major suppliers of the Group are terminal machinery, components, oils and lubricants suppliers and ferry owners. Under the principles of 'transparency, fairness, impartiality and honesty', the Group has established a comprehensive tendering evaluation system and set up stringent supplier screening procedures in the Management Measures for Tendering and Bidding and the Procedures of Procurement Management, regulating the management of different types of suppliers of the Group. A total of 234 suppliers were covered in the evaluation during the Reporting Period. The Group's Technical Support Department works closely together with relevant departments to identify suitable suppliers and to assess their qualifications and performance. At least three potential suppliers would be invited for tendering for the Group to choose the right suppliers.

To prevent forced labour, the Group properly regulates employees' working hours and rest periods.
